author: SledHead52003
body: Hello, this was not recent but a while ago I was on the avicus server on ctf. I myself SledHead52003 were sky bridging across when sudden the block placed and then vanish therefore looked like I was flying because I was still on the block. If you ever noticed someone skybridging high you cant see the blocks just the player so one of the admins IceJJFish banned me for fly hacks. Please appeal this ban the I love the server so much and I dont hack! Thanks!

replies.body:
Hello,

Regardless if you did indeed use fly hacks or if it was block lag I have accepted your appeal as the infractions dates nearly a year ago and I think you've served your time. Welcome back to Avicus! :)
-Accepted

Regards,
Auratix,
Senior Moderator
